#  41417 - Web - based Collaborative Engineering Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **41417 - module is no longer offered from WS 2011/12**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Web - based Collaborative Engineering**  |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 4 - Environmental Sciences and Process Engineering   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. PD Dr.-Ing. habil. Molkenthin, Frank 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every winter semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | Understanding of and experiences in Web-based collaborative engineering in research and professional projects distributed team work and management in “virtual environment” based on information sharing.  |  
| Contents:  |  Introduction of Web-based collaboration and related working methods, central and distributed collaboration, synchronous and asynchronous collaboration, time management and time shift working; coordination, cooperation and competition; team management, documentation and reporting in engineering projects.Information exchange and information sharing interaction agreements, version and access control, Web-based tools for conferencing (chat, audio, video), application sharing, web-based project platforms (CSWS), engineering reports based on the media paper and on the media Web. Team work exercise “HydroWeb”: teams from several EuroAquae partner universities are working on a river management project via Internet as independent units using Web technology to overcome the spatial distribution.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 20 Hours 
  * Practical training / 4 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 40 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | see http://euroaquae.tu-cottbus.de  |  
| Module Examination:  | Unspecified - Specification from winter semester 2016/17 required!  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | collaborative online team work and management; Web-based team reports and presentations; individual questionnaire  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | None  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | - online team work with EuroAquae partner- Lecturer: Molkenthin   |  
| Module Components:  | None  |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |
